decisions.id: Summary/TC: one write session, at most ten new registry keys, best-evidenced first
decisions.summary: The whole answer is written in ONE write session capped at ten new registry keys, the best-evidenced sources first, with no continuation for the rest.
decisions.why: The sources behind passes/a-bales.md sections 1-7 include at least 14 that are not in research/sources (URL and NDL-pid grep, 2026-11-24: NDL 1077861, 1178389, 2547651, 2547702, 2548494, 2548603, 2587102, 2587455, 2587751, 920967, ghosts.xrea.jp yore-092, scrapbox chouroudaigaku, seiryo-u.ac.jp, the Shizuoka sumi.pdf). Ten keys, best-evidenced first, in one session therefore drops findings FR-001/FR-002 require written, and the request asked for each part. Not physically impossible: the project's own rule (research/CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.md 'Research') sends the eleventh key to a continuation brief. Fix: 'at most ten new registry keys a write session; the eleventh sends the rest to a continuation write session (make reserve), and no finding is dropped for the cap' and Summary 'one write session (and its continuations under the key cap)'.

decisions.id: D1: neighbors '(mats, matting, rope, earth bags)'
decisions.summary: The neighbors written into the question are only the ones with figures found; the request's rice bales and sandals are not listed.
decisions.why: The request names rice bales first, then straw mats, sandals and rope, as the neighbors; the spec gives rice bales' price and sandals SILENT verdicts that FR-001/FR-005 require carried with what is still open. A list of only the found neighbors drops two named parts. Fix: '(mats, matting, rope, earth bags; empty rice bales - the 1859 order without a price - and sandals SILENT, named with what is still open)'.
